sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Single entry for generated API code
sections.what: Passes on all the names from the generated API file and the generated types file, so callers import from one place.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the generated file layout hidden from callers.
sections.watch_out: Regenerating the source files with new names can silently change what this package exports.

summary: Entry file that gathers all exports from the generated API and type files into one import point.
purpose: Gives callers a single place to import API validation code from.
why: Likely reason: hides the generated file layout so callers do not need to know it.
how: It re-exports everything from the generated API file, then everything from the generated types file. It contains no logic of its own.
inputs: The files src/generated/api and src/generated/types, which are not in the packet.
outputs: All names exported by those two generated files.
risks: If the generated files are missing, renamed, or regenerated with different names, every import from this package breaks.
debug: Confirm the generated files exist. If an import is missing, check whether both generated files export that name.
